name: research-governance-v1
title: Research governance v1
purpose: Machine-readable research governance rules under the standing freeze. These rules bind any future experiment, holdout, dataset use and decision record; they do not authorize research, collection or trading.

rules.subject: EXP-M4-0001
rules.statement: EXP-M4-0001 is a historical synthetic experiment whose holdout was consumed once after selection; it must not be relabelled UNTOUCHED, reused, extended or re-split for any new decision.

rules.subject: experiment_registration
rules.statement: No new experiment registration, variant, rerun or holdout selection is permitted while the freeze holds; registration requires a separate versioned owner decision that explicitly lifts this rule.

rules.subject: future_research_holdout
rules.statement: Any future research must define and record a fresh, previously unused holdout before selection; no prior synthetic holdout may serve as that holdout.

rules.subject: dataset
rules.statement: A rights-approved, accepted dataset with written owner authorization is required before any research result may be treated as admitted evidence; UNKNOWN rights and BLOCKED acceptance remain blocking.

rules.subject: alpha_claims
rules.statement: A positive synthetic screen, including EXP-M4-0001, is not alpha certification, not a production-readiness claim and not permission to trade or to contact a provider.

rules.subject: future_decision_record
rules.statement: Any future decision record must carry the lineage fields listed in decision_record_required_lineage; a record without them is rejected, not treated as partial evidence.

claims_prohibited: fresh or untouched holdout based on EXP-M4-0001
admitted dataset without rights approval and acceptance
research registration while the freeze holds
production readiness or live trading permission from any research result

negative_cases.case: reuse EXP-M4-0001 holdout for a new decision
register a new experiment while freeze holds
select on the historical synthetic holdout and call it fresh
treat UNKNOWN-rights data as admitted evidence
claim alpha from the EXP-M4-0001 positive screen
decision record missing code_digest or holdout_disposition
